verdict.rationale: Pigment's finance page says its own platform is "easily integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports," which supports automated data ingestion without manual exports. It never names QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite, and never describes actuals landing in the model. The Agent Connectors (Notion, Drive, Slack) are a different capability and are not credited. Missing for 10: named QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite connectors, documentation of actuals syncing into models, setup and refresh-cadence details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
